name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd (Nykaa)
basis: Consolidated (Screener.in, fetched 24-Nov-2026; Q2FY27 and Sep-2026 balance sheet ignored under the as-of rule)

segments.beauty: Beauty and personal care (BPC): Nykaa app and website, 324 stores in 105 cities (Jun-2026), owned brands (House of Nykaa: Nykaa Cosmetics, Kay Beauty, Dot & Key, Nykaa Skin RX and others), Superstore by Nykaa (eB2B distribution to ~523k small retailers) and Nykaa Man grooming. Includes Nykaa Now (60-minute delivery in 13 cities).
segments.fashion: Nykaa Fashion (curated premium fashion marketplace), LBB and Nykaa Man lifestyle; runs Nike.in and the Nike app in India since Feb-2026.
segments.others: GCC (Gulf) and international businesses; small and loss-making.

superstore.note: GMV hit by GST-led MRP cuts; normalises from Q3FY27 (CEO Vishal Gupta)

q1fy27.aminu: Board approved buying 51% of Aminu Wellness (premium skincare) for ₹32 cr; remaining 49% over the next few years; closing expected Q2FY27

guidanceAndCall.item: FY30 ambition: GMV 2.5-3x FY26 ($5bn+), EBITDA 4-5x FY26 (₹750 cr) with an early-to-mid-teens margin, ROCE 40%+
Beauty GMV 2.5-3x by FY30 with a healthy double-digit EBITDA margin; ~600 stores by FY30 (313 in FY26); House of Nykaa 2.5-3x
Fashion 3-3.5x FY26 scale by FY30 with a high-single-digit EBITDA margin; reiterated on the Q1 call (CEO Abhijeet Dabas)
Superstore (eB2B): GMV ₹3,500 cr by FY30 (35%+ a year) and EBITDA breakeven by FY30
No retailer-funded discounting: discounts are funded by brands; same prices on Nykaa Now and the main app (Anchit Nayar, Q1 call)
Nike partnership enters the base in mid-Q4FY27; management says Fashion growth is mostly the underlying platform

capex.src: FY26 annual report (consolidated balance sheet and cash flow)

history.event: Company incorporated; Falguni Nayar a director since 24-Apr-2012
House of Nykaa starts with one owned brand (Nykaa Cosmetics)
IPO at ₹1,125 (₹187.5 after the 2022 bonus); listed 10-Nov-2021 at ~₹2,001, a 78% premium
5:1 bonus issue (record date 11-Nov-2022); pre-IPO lock-in expiry the same month
Buys 51% of Dot & Key (skincare), with a put option on the other 49%
Raises its Earth Rhythm stake to 74.6%, with a call option on the rest
Takes over Nike.in and the Nike app in India (full-stack partnership)

management: Founder, Executive Chairperson, MD and CEO
Executive Director, co-founder, CEO House of Nykaa brands
Founder's husband (spouse per FY26 annual report)

governance.src: FY26 annual report (governance highlights, p.130; consolidated accounts)

accounting.ebitdaDefinition: Reported EBITDA = PBT + finance cost + depreciation - other income; ESOP cost is inside; rent on leased stores and warehouses is below EBITDA (Ind AS 116)
accounting.putOption: Dot & Key put option liability ₹269.5 cr at Mar-26 (₹135.9 cr at Mar-25), revalued through equity
accounting.minorities: Profit attributable to minorities ₹4.5 cr in FY26; owners' profit ₹199.44 cr; basic EPS ₹0.70
accounting.src: FY26 annual report, consolidated P&L, balance sheet and note 28 / 53

sharesOutstanding.basis: Equity share capital ₹286.33 cr of ₹1 shares at Mar-26
